info.title: Donghaeng Finance AI HTTP API
info.description: Contract for the local text-first finance interview API. JSON responses always use the data/error/meta envelope. The event stream is described in more detail by asyncapi.json. An external production identity provider is not implemented; production startup and direct API authentication are fail-closed.

x-production-authentication.description: Local password and persisted local-workspace session authentication are forbidden in production. The automated custom-server smoke harness is the only exception and requires an explicit flag, matching literal-loopback bind host, port, and application origin, plus an in-process attestation of the actual bind. Environment variables alone never enable local authentication in a direct Next deployment.

post.summary: Dry-run or enforce bounded retention cleanup
post.description: Requires an authenticated principal with the ADMIN role. dryRun defaults to true. Transcript, evidence, audit, and FINAL snapshot artifacts are always protected.

200.description: Retention candidates and deleted row counts

post.summary: Create or return the local workspace session
post.description: Local-development bootstrap endpoint. Implementations must not expose bootstrap in a production deployment.

200.description: The idempotent local bootstrap completed and a session was issued

Set-Cookie.description: HttpOnly, SameSite session cookie for the bootstrapped local user

201.description: The local identity was created and a session was issued

Set-Cookie.description: HttpOnly, SameSite session cookie for the bootstrapped local user

post.summary: Authenticate a local user and create a session

Set-Cookie.description: HttpOnly, SameSite session cookie. Secure is required outside local HTTP development.

get.summary: Return the authenticated tenant and user
Get the durable PREVIEW or immutable FINAL snapshot
get.description: ACTIVE interviews return PREVIEW. Completed interviews are read from the immutable FINAL snapshot and never reconstructed as PREVIEW.

post.description: All four core fields are required. clientMessageId is the idempotency key, expectedVersion provides compare-and-swap protection, and currentQuestionInfoCode (a string or null) prevents submission against a stale question. Only one PENDING command may exist per tenant/interview. A bounded database lease prevents two processes from calling Claude for the same command; competing requests return MESSAGE_STAGE_PENDING or MESSAGE_STAGE_BUSY without another provider call.

200.description: Accepted turn and its transactionally consistent PREVIEW snapshot

post.summary: Append an idempotent correction to a FINAL transcript segment
post.description: The command atomically advances the aggregate version, retains immutable raw text, appends a correction record, runs synchronous reprocessing, and commits one ordered outbox batch. A transcript referenced by a PENDING Claude command returns TRANSCRIPT_PROCESSING_PENDING so correction cannot invalidate the exact durable retry payload.

200.description: Stored correction, corrected segment, aggregate cursor, and emitted event batch

post.description: Repeated completion with the same clientCommandId and identical payload returns the stored result. COMPLETE enforces every completion gate. FORCE_INCOMPLETE records an intentionally incomplete FINAL snapshot, never creates an evaluation, and requires a non-blank reason. Both modes return PENDING_MESSAGE_COMMAND while any durable answer is awaiting or actively undergoing Claude processing, preventing FINAL from discarding that transcript result.

200.description: Existing or newly generated FINAL snapshot and evaluation

get.summary: Replay and follow the interview event stream
get.description: Returns ordered Server-Sent Events. The SSE id field is the durable numeric sequence. Reconnect with Last-Event-ID to replay events strictly after that sequence. A 409 EVENT_REPLAY_GAP requires a GET /interviews/{id} snapshot resync before reconnecting.

200.description: SSE stream. Each data field is one event envelope documented in asyncapi.json.

Cache-Control.description: Streaming responses must not be cached

get.description: Returns searchable interview data-quality summaries. A-E values are data-quality grades only and never official or inferred credit grades.

200.description: Tenant-scoped evaluation summaries and filter facets

get.description: The id may identify the evaluation or its interview for backward compatibility. Tenant isolation applies in both cases.

get.summary: Get the authenticated user's latest interview consent decisions
get.description: Absent, revoked, or expired decisions are effective false. Both feature flags therefore default to false. With require, a missing effective decision returns 403 MICROPHONE_CONSENT_REQUIRED or RAW_AUDIO_STORAGE_CONSENT_REQUIRED; an invalid value returns 400 INVALID_CONSENT_PURPOSE.

200.description: Latest microphone and raw-audio-storage consent decisions

post.summary: Append an immutable consent grant or revocation decision

200.description: PREVIEW or FINAL information item projection

get.summary: Get derived features and the evidence-linked summary

200.description: PREVIEW live or FINAL immutable feature projection

Get persisted FINAL evaluation goal artifacts
Get the immutable FINAL evidence manifest for an evaluation

sessionCookie.name: donghaeng_session
sessionCookie.description: Opaque local-development session token. Only a SHA-256 digest is persisted by the server. It is not a production identity mechanism; production is fail-closed until an external IdP/session adapter is implemented.

RequestId.description: Request correlation identifier; identical to meta.requestId in JSON responses

LastEventId.name: Last-Event-ID
LastEventId.description: Last fully applied numeric SSE id. The server replays events with a greater sequence.

ConsentRequirement.name: require
ConsentRequirement.description: Require the selected effective consent before returning state

Forbidden.description: The authenticated principal cannot perform this action

NotFound.description: The tenant-scoped resource was not found

Conflict.description: Version, idempotency-key, lifecycle, or state conflict

UnprocessableEntity.description: Syntactically valid request that cannot be applied

InternalServerError.description: Unexpected server failure with no sensitive details

ReplayGap.description: EVENT_REPLAY_GAP: the requested event is older than the retained stream. Reload the interview snapshot before reconnecting.

BootstrapRequest.description: Empty object. The local workspace identity is server-controlled and only available outside production.

industryCode.description: Server allow-listed SOHO industry profile. Industry-only candidates remain suggested until a parser/evidence policy exists.

CreateInterviewRequest.description: Omit requiredInformationList (send {}) to use the server-owned dev-v1 catalog. industryCode selects one of eleven allow-listed SOHO profiles; catalog-only candidates are not silently promoted into completion requirements. Supply profile for a borrower-created interview; the server never seeds presumed sales, platform, or business facts.

lastEventSeq.description: Highest durable outbox sequence committed for this interview

pendingCommand.description: Tenant-authorized, allow-listed descriptor for exactly resuming one durable PENDING answer after reload. Server lease tokens, request hashes, prompts, credentials, and provider bodies are excluded.

evaluationId.description: Persisted evaluation identifier, or null for FORCE_INCOMPLETE

score.description: Interview data-quality score only; null when the item is ungraded. It is not a credit score.

grade.description: Interview data-quality grade only; never an official or inferred credit grade.

source.description: Distinct evidence sources joined deterministically, or null when no source is available.

overallScore.description: Interview data-quality score only; it is not a credit score.

overallLevel.description: Interview data-quality grade only; it is not a credit grade.

clientCorrectionId.description: Client-generated idempotency key, unique within an interview

expiresAt.description: When supplied, must be a canonical future ISO timestamp

cloudAiProcessingEnabled.description: Whether the current user has an effective versioned decision allowing FINAL transcript and interview-state processing by the configured external Claude provider

items.description: Canonical information record for the selected snapshot

clientMessageId.description: Client-generated idempotency key, unique within an interview

expectedVersion.description: Aggregate version observed before this command

currentQuestionInfoCode.description: Question the borrower is answering; used to reject stale UI submissions

transcriptMetadata.description: Optional timing and STT provenance for a final audio transcript

endMs.description: When both bounds are supplied, endMs must be greater than or equal to startMs

PendingMessageCommand.description: Exact safe command fields required for an explicit same-id retry. PROCESSING means a bounded server-side provider lease is active; retrying while active returns a conflict without another provider call.

clientCommandId.description: Client-generated idempotency key, unique within an interview

expectedVersion.description: Aggregate version observed before this command

reason.description: Required and non-blank for FORCE_INCOMPLETE; optional context (or null) for COMPLETE

TurnPlannerMetadata.description: Safe turn-planner telemetry only. Credentials, prompts, transcript text, raw provider errors, and stack traces are never included.

processing.description: Transcript durability outcome. RETRYABLE_FAILURE is reserved for explicitly retryable provider timeout/network/429/5xx failures, preserves the FINAL transcript and one PENDING stage, releases the bounded processing lease, and writes no receipt. NON_RETRYABLE_FAILURE preserves the transcript but terminalizes the stage as FAILED and receipt-caches the generic safe response at the unchanged aggregate version, so the same id never calls the provider again. Retries are never automatic.
